channel.title: The Proteus AI blog
channel.description: Plain answers on AI deal desks, agent negotiation, USDC escrow and selling to AI agents. Every claim matches our docs, and anything not done yet says so.

item.title: What is an AI deal desk? How autonomous agents negotiate and close B2B deals
item.description: An AI deal desk quotes, negotiates and closes deals inside a business's own rules, then turns the agreement into a paid transaction. Here is how it works.

item.title: How to let an AI negotiate for your business without giving away your margin
item.description: Seven guardrails that let an AI agent negotiate prices for your business while your floor, costs and approval rules stay in your control.

item.title: Get paid on delivery: USDC escrow for small business orders
item.description: How USDC escrow lets a buyer pay up front and a business get paid only for what it delivers, with automatic refunds, no gas for buyers and funding from 25 chains.

item.title: How AI agents can buy safely: budgets, seller checks and MCP
item.description: What an AI agent needs to buy on its owner's behalf without overspending or paying the wrong seller: a spending mandate, on-chain seller checks and escrow.

item.title: Selling on WhatsApp with an AI agent: five rules for trust, privacy and payment
item.description: How to put an AI sales agent on a business's WhatsApp without taking payments in chat, exposing customers' numbers or breaking Meta's rules.

item.title: What is ERC-8004? Verifiable identity for AI agents that sell
item.description: ERC-8004 gives an AI agent an on-chain identity: who owns it, where it gets paid and which key signs for it. Here is how sellers use it and how buyers check it.

item.title: How to accept USDC from any chain: Circle CCTP into Arc
item.description: Your customers hold USDC on Solana, Base or Ethereum. Here is how Circle CCTP brings it to Arc as native USDC, so they can pay you without a wrapped token or a bridge they have to trust.

item.title: Usage-based pricing for APIs and AI services: prepaid, metered and refundable
item.description: How to sell an API or AI service by usage without chasing invoices: a prepaid balance in escrow, every call metered with a signed receipt, and unused credit refundable.
